record.original_question: Given a function f in D^alpha such that f does not have an analytic extension to the closed disk, find the rate of decay of ||q_n f - 1||_alpha.

evidence.quote: Open Question 5. Given a function f in D^alpha such that f does not have an analytic extension to the closed disk, find the rate of decay of ||q_n f - 1||_alpha.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a real parameter $\alpha$, let $D^\alpha$ denote the Dirichlet-type space of analytic functions $f(z)=\sum_{k=0}^\infty a_k z^k$ on the open unit disk $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ equipped with the norm
$$\|f\|_\alpha^2 = \sum_{k=0}^\infty (k+1)^\alpha |a_k|^2,$$
so that $D^0$ is the Hardy space $H^2$, $D^1$ is the classical Dirichlet space, and $D^{-1}$ is the Bergman space.

For $f\in D^\alpha$ with $f\not\equiv 0$ and each nonnegative integer $n$, let $q_n=q_n[f]$ be the optimal polynomial approximant to $1/f$ of degree at most $n$, i.e., the unique polynomial of degree $\le n$ minimizing
$$\|q f - 1\|_\alpha$$
over all polynomials $q\in\mathcal{P}_n$. It is known that if $f$ is cyclic in $D^\alpha$ (which holds in particular whenever $f$ has no zeros in $\overline{\mathbb{D}}$) then $\|q_n f - 1\|_\alpha \to 0$ as $n\to\infty$.

Problem. Suppose $f\in D^\alpha$ is cyclic but does not extend analytically across the closed unit disk $\overline{\mathbb{D}}$. Determine the rate of decay of
$$\|q_n f - 1\|_\alpha$$
as $n\to\infty$.
artifact.category_tag: optimal polynomial approximants in Dirichlet-type spaces
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in a recent survey on optimal polynomial approximants. While specific lower bounds (e.g., lacunary examples in $H^2$ with decay no faster than $1/(\log n)^{1+\varepsilon}$) and certain explicit-rate results for functions with analytic extension across $\overline{\mathbb{D}}$ are known, the general rate of decay for $f\in D^\alpha$ without analytic extension to the closed disk remains unresolved in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: A survey of optimal polynomial approximants, applications to digital filter design, and related open problems
status_evidence.snippet: survey examines known results about optimal polynomial approximants ... their rates of decay ... open questions remaining
status_evidence.claim: The decay rate of ||q_n f - 1||_alpha for general f in D^alpha without analytic extension to the closed disk is listed among open problems.

status_evidence.title: Optimal Polynomial Approximants in Lp
status_evidence.snippet: Optimal polynomial approximants in Lp settings
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work continues to study decay rates but does not settle the general D^alpha case.
